channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Explosion rocks Sanaa; missiles intercepted over Riyadh
item.description: A blast hits Sanaa after air strikes near the airport, as the Saudi coalition intercepts missiles over Riyadh.

item.title: Houthis target Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea ports as strikes escalate
item.description: Explosion reported in Sanaa after Saudi air defenses intercept ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh.

item.title: Deadly truck fire is latest of Egypt’s transport disasters
item.description: Dozens were killed and injured when a truck carrying gas cylinders caught fire near Cairo’s Ring Road.

item.title: Dozens killed in Egypt vehicle fire
item.description: At least 30 have been ⁠killed and ⁠15 injured when a vehicle carrying ‌petroleum products caught fire in Egypt.

item.title: Could renewed strikes on Hodeidah port worsen Yemen’s humanitarian crisis?
item.description: Disruptions at Yemen's largest seaport could exacerbate hardships for millions of Yemenis, aid experts warn.

item.title: At least 30 killed in Egypt vehicle fire, health ministry says
item.description: An additional 15 were injured in blaze after vehicle carrying petroleum products flipped on a major road.

item.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
item.description: Another 21 are injured after the tanker reportedly overturns on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital.

item.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
item.description: The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.

item.title: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
item.description: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.

item.title: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas security official and family in Gaza City
item.description: Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, was killed with his wife and two teenage daughters, doctors say.
